instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Lumina Dynamics is a specialty coffee and gourmet food retailer operating six physical locations, underpinned by an e-commerce channel. The company focuses on high-margin, artisanal products, maintaining in-house roasting capabilities and curating over 200 unique items to serve discerning urban customers. Currently, the core challenge lies in scaling operational efficiency and building a robust subscription loyalty framework.
answers.pastInitiatives: Innovation is embedded in our operating rhythm through structured quarterly hackathons and a formal patent portfolio management system. We also utilize a rotating 'innovation fellow' program to dedicate high-potential employees to exploratory projects, demonstrating a commitment to continuous learning and process improvement.
answers.strategicGoals: We are heavily dependent on our top three product categories and concentrated customer base, creating significant revenue vulnerability. Our primary goal is aggressive diversification by identifying adjacent market segments—including new wholesale partners or entirely new private-label food lines—to reduce single-source risk.
answers.additionalContext: Operating in a high-pressure specialty food market requires constant adaptation to evolving sourcing costs and consumer trends. The current lean structure means innovation relies heavily on maximizing the output of existing operational staff.
answers.teamSize: We have 2 generalist developers who split their time between maintaining our existing systems, handling customer support escalations, and occasionally prototyping new features. There is no dedicated innovation or R&D role — innovation happens when these developers have spare cycles between urgent operational tasks, which is rare.

opportunities.title: Product Portfolio Diversification (Niche Expansion)
opportunities.rationale: Given the conservative risk profile and low budget, incremental diversification is safer. This involves launching a small capsule of hyper-niche, regionally sourced artisanal products that appeal to an adjacent customer segment without requiring massive capital or operational overhaul.

first_actions: Identify 3 underrepresented product niches (e.g., specific regional coffee roasts).
Develop a pilot line for the niche with minimal inventory commitment.
Test pricing and marketing messaging on existing e-commerce channels.
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve 10% of new revenue from the pilot line within Q3.
milestones: Finalize niche sourcing and contract by Month 2
Launch and gather feedback on pilot line (Month 4)
Scale to 5% of total sales in Month 6

opportunities.title: B2B Wholesale Subscription Service (Diversification)
opportunities.rationale: To mitigate customer concentration risk, the company should explore a bold shift into B2B wholesale. This involves creating a curated 'Office Coffee' or 'Gourmet Pantry' subscription model specifically targeting small offices and boutique hospitality venues, leveraging existing inventory expertise.

first_actions: Develop a tiered B2B wholesale catalog focused on recurring office/cafe needs.
Identify 5 potential anchor B2B partners for pilot contracts.
Establish the minimum viable subscription fulfillment process.
resources_needed: Time from small leadership team (dedicated project oversight)
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure 3 recurring B2B wholesale contracts representing $5,000 MRR within the first year.
milestones: Finalize wholesale packaging and pricing structure (Month 3)
Onboard first 3 anchor clients and launch pilot service (Month 6)
Establish self-service ordering portal for B2B customers (Month 9)

opportunities.title: Optimized E-commerce Conversion Flow
opportunities.rationale: Leveraging existing digital maturity (3), the company should focus on incremental improvements to its e-commerce site. This includes simple UI/UX changes and targeted SEO that utilizes basic data analytics to improve conversion rates without requiring complex new technology.

first_actions: Conduct A/B testing on top 5 product pages' layouts.
Implement improved mobile responsiveness checks across all devices.
Improve checkout abandonment rate by targeting friction points identified in customer research.
resources_needed: Time allocation from 2 generalist developers (10 hours total)
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase e-commerce conversion rate by 8% within six months.
milestones: Implement A/B tests on top 5 pages (Month 4)
Analyze data and implement winning changes company-wide (Month 6)

next_steps.action: Conduct a deep dive feasibility study on the B2B wholesale subscription model.
Assign one generalist developer to lead the UX optimization initiative and schedule consultant onboarding.

key_weaknesses: Severe capital constraint (3% budget) limiting scaling potential.
Lack of dedicated, specialized R&D talent within the core team.
Time scarcity forcing innovation to occur only during non-operational cycles.
High dependence on a single product category and concentrated customer base.
